data.name: CompanySelectHint
data.value: Choose the company whose warehouse you work in. Nothing is shown until a company is chosen.

data.name: CompanyUnavailable
data.value: The company list cannot be read right now; try again shortly.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_ASSIGNEE_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE
data.value: The user directory cannot be reached; the assignee was not checked and nothing was saved. Try again shortly.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_ASSIGNEE_INVALID
data.value: Choose an active user of your company as the assignee.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_COMPANY_CODE_INVALID
data.value: The company code is not valid for task numbers; correct the company code first.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_CONFIRMATION_CONFLICT_RETRY
data.value: The stock changed while the confirmation was posting; the confirmation is waiting — use “Retry”.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_CONFIRMATION_IN_FLIGHT
data.value: This confirmation is being processed right now; wait a moment and refresh.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_CONFIRMATION_NOT_RESOLVABLE
data.value: Only a confirmation with an integrity error can be reconciled.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_CONFIRMATION_NOT_RETRYABLE
data.value: Only a waiting confirmation can be retried.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_CONFIRMATION_PENDING
data.value: A confirmation of this task is waiting for the stock answer; only “Retry” works until it is settled.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_CONFLICT
data.value: Someone changed this record meanwhile; refresh and try again.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_INVALID_TRANSITION
data.value: This action is not possible in the task’s current state.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_LOCATION_HAS_OPEN_TASKS
data.value: The location has open putaway tasks; close or cancel them first.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_LOCATION_ROLE_CONFLICT
data.value: A location cannot be Receiving and Staging at once.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_LOCATION_ROLE_EXISTS
data.value: This location already has a role record; edit that one.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_LOCATION_ROLE_INHERITED_CONFLICT
data.value: An upper or lower node already carries the opposite role; Receiving and Staging cannot meet on one path.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_LOCATION_ROLE_NOT_FOUND
data.value: The role record was not found; refresh the list.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_LOCATION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED
data.value: A role can be given to a warehouse, storage location, zone or bin only.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_NOT_ASSIGNEE
data.value: Only the assigned operator or a supervisor can do this.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_POSTING_INTEGRITY_ERROR
data.value: The stock ledger already holds a different movement under this confirmation’s key; a supervisor must reconcile it.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_QUANTITY_BELOW_CONFIRMED
data.value: The planned quantity cannot be below what is already confirmed or waiting.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_OPEN
data.value: The quantity is more than the stock still open in this row.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING
data.value: The quantity is more than what remains to put away.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_RECORD_CODE_UNAVAILABLE
data.value: A task number could not be issued; try again shortly.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_SERIAL_BUCKET_CHANGED
data.value: The serial numbers at the source changed; cancel this task and open a new one.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_SERIAL_BUCKET_MIXED_STATUS
data.value: Part of this lot at the same location is awaiting quality; complete the quality decision first.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_SERIAL_PARTIAL_NOT_SUPPORTED
data.value: A serial-controlled product is put away in full only; partial confirmation and closing the remainder are not possible.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_SOURCE_NOT_RECEIVING
data.value: The source location is not a receiving location.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_SOURCE_STOCK_NOT_FOUND
data.value: No stock was found in the selected row; refresh the list.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_STOCK_NOT_PUTAWAY_ELIGIBLE
data.value: The stock went into quarantine or is held; it cannot be put away.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_STORAGE_CONDITIONS_UNKNOWN
data.value: Storage condition unknown — complete it on the product card (MDM).

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_STORAGE_CONDITION_INVALID
data.value: The storage conditions are not valid: choose at most one temperature condition.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_STORAGE_CONDITION_MISMATCH

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED
data.value: The target must be an active, stockable bin of the same warehouse that is not a receiving or staging location.

data.name: Warehouse.Error.WMS_TASK_ALREADY_ASSIGNED
